name: pnr_vote_guest_declines
title: NCR point of no return: the guest says Not yet
description: VMQ05 is set to stage 70 ('Talk to Colonel Moore') and both players stand at Moore. Activating Moore opens the endgame confirm box on the host (buttons: 0 'I'm not ready yet.', 1 'Let's do this!'; message ids in plugin/dialogue/data/consent_messages.txt, not in out/questdata so not referenced here). When the host presses 'Let's do this!', every other player gets a Ready / Not yet consent prompt (docs/dialogue-design.md section 12); the script resumes with confirm only if all are Ready, and any Not yet or a timeout means decline. Stage 100 starts the Hoover Dam battle, so the world is unnameable afterwards and the next jump reloads. Pressing a message box button and answering the consent prompt need bridge methods that do not exist yet (names provisional, asked of T6a), so those steps are blocked until they do. This variant: the host confirms but the guest answers Not yet; VMQ05 must stay at stage 70 on every machine.
